profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | AI Product & Frontend Architecture | React · Watson Orchestrate · IBM
profile.summary:
Building the human-facing layer of AI systems — the interfaces where users actually meet artificial intelligence.
 
With 20+ years of engineering experience and nearly a decade at IBM, I'm currently a Senior Software Engineer and technical lead on Watson Orchestrate, IBM's AI agent builder platform. I own the Knowledge feature UI end-to-end — from roadmap and design sessions through implementation, testing, and deployment. I'm also leading an active initiative to migrate enterprise customers from Watson Assistant to Watson Orchestrate, helping high-value clients transition to IBM's next-generation AI platform.
 
My core craft is React-based frontend architecture for complex, data-intensive products. I've shipped production features used by enterprise customers at scale, maintained 100% automated test coverage, and built analytics tooling that gives users visibility into AI performance. I've also been a consistent mentor and knowledge-sharer — helping junior engineers grow and conducting technical interviews to raise the bar on our team.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer — Tech Lead
positions.description:
•	Technical lead for the Knowledge feature on Watson Orchestrate, IBM's AI agent builder platform. Own the UI end-to-end — participating in roadmap planning, design reviews, sprint grooming, and delivery across the Knowledge squad.
•	Leading an enterprise customer migration effort from Watson Assistant to Watson Orchestrate, working cross-functionally to transition high-value accounts to IBM's next-generation AI platform.
•	Core contributor to Watson Assistant (SaaS conversational AI product), driving development of major frontend features with a focus on user experience and performance.
•	Built frontend analytics features that surface chatbot performance insights, enabling customers to diagnose and improve their AI deployments.
•	Maintained 100% automated unit test coverage across developed features; designed and executed A/B experiments on the production UI.
•	DevOps on-call engineer for CI/CD pipeline — resolved production issues and ensured zero-downtime deployments.
•	Mentored junior engineers and conducted technical interviews and resume screenings to support team growth and hiring bar.
positions.insights: Front-End Development, Software Architecture and +3 skills

positions.title: Senior Cloud Engineer
positions.description:
•	Lead developer providing cloud-based software development for the Department of State under the Office of the Chief Architect.
•	Developed web application for Foreign Affairs Network using C# and MVC architecture. The application provides a cloud-based global information delivery environment. Integrated third-party solutions for customer collaboration services (i.e. Google Apps). Wrote unit tests for the application. 
•	Created dev, test, and production cloud environments using Amazon Web Services (AWS) platform and scripted automated deployment for each environment.

positions.title: Project Engineer Staff
positions.description:
•	Managed multidisciplinary development projects with 20+ team members; Employed proactive management style ensuring operational proficiency and timely completion of assigned projects within or under timeframe and budget.
•	Worked with technical managers to coordinate internal resources, cost, scope, timeline, and milestone specifications. Assigned tasks to team members and set milestones to monitor progress.
•	Created a detailed project plan with well-defined tasks, milestones, client sign-offs, and specifications, which served to communicate project progress to management. Delivered complete products to include thorough engineering and design documentation. Presented technical briefings and project plan to management.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Software lead for the entire program, established development priorities, created software
processes/procedures while providing daily direction to the software team.
• Technical development lead implementing Mashups (web application hybrid) to combine customer datasets with open datasets (Google Maps, NOAA, Census, USGS); troubleshot issues and managed subcontractors. Trained the customer and other engineers on the application.
• Control Account Manager (CAM) for the software budget and schedule.

positions.title: Senior Computer Systems Architect
positions.description:
•	Managed system-level requirements for the entire program and fulfillment to the customer. Coordinated the closeout of changes to the established baseline and the creation of new baselines. 
•	Executed engineering change proposals by working across the entire technical team. 
•	Key customer liaison for requirements and baseline change control.
